name: Battle of Pirates
subtitle: Aim, swipe, sink
description: Two fleets, one stretch of open water, and one cannon each. Drag back to set your angle and power, read the wind, and take turns pounding the other side until it goes under. Play it as a duel, 2v2 or 3v3 — against the bot, sharing a device, or online.
controls: Drag back from your ship with a mouse or a finger and let go to fire. Arrows fine-tune, Space fires.
